name: Warwick
title: the Uncaged Wrath of Zaun

WarwickE.name: Primal Howl
WarwickE.tooltip: Warwick gains @DRAmount@% damage reduction for @DRDuration@ seconds. After it ends, Warwick howls, <status>Fearing</status> nearby enemies for @FearDuration@ second. Warwick can <recast>Recast</recast> to end the Ability early.

damageRefs.context: Warwick's Attacks deal an additional [{OnHitDamage} magic damage] On-Hit. If Warwick is below @HealingThreshold*100@%

WarwickP.name: Eternal Hunger
WarwickP.tooltip:
Warwick's Attacks deal an additional @OnHitDamage@ magic damage On-Hit.

If Warwick is below @HealingThreshold*100@% Health, he also heals for @HealingRatio*100@% of the damage dealt by Eternal Hunger. If Warwick is below @EmpoweredHealingThreshold*100@% health, the healing is increased to @EmpoweredHealingRatio*100@% of the damage dealt.

WarwickW.name: Blood Hunt
WarwickW.tooltip:
Passive: Warwick can sense champions below 50% Health, gaining @PassiveMSBonus@% Move Speed towards them. Spells and attacks against enemies below 50% Health grant @PassiveASBonus@% Attack Speed. These effects are increased by 200% against enemies below 25% Health.

Active: Warwick can briefly sense all enemies, and gains this Ability's passive effect against the closest champion for 8 seconds, regardless of Health. If no champions are found, this Ability's cooldown is reduced by 30%.
Warwick can only passively sense enemies who were brought below 50% Health by allies.

damageRefs.context: the first champion he collides with while he channels for @RDuration@ seconds. He attacks that champion 3 times over the duration, dealing [{DamageCumulative} magic damage] . Warwick heals for 100% of all damage dealt</heali

WarwickR.name: Infinite Duress
WarwickR.tooltip:
Warwick leaps a huge distance that scales with his Move Speed, Suppressing the first champion he collides with while he channels for @RDuration@ seconds. He attacks that champion 3 times over the duration, dealing @DamageCumulative@ magic damage. Warwick heals for 100% of all damage dealt during the channel.
This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects 3 distinct times over its duration, and does not Critically Strike.
This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

damageRefs.context: Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing [{BaseBiteDamage} plus {TargetPercentHPDamage}% max Health magic damage] and healing for @LifestealPercent@% of the damage
Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing [{BaseBiteDamage} plus {TargetPercentHPDamage}% max Health magic damage] and healing for @LifestealPercent@% of the damage

WarwickQ.name: Jaws of the Beast
WarwickQ.tooltip:
Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing @BaseBiteDamage@ plus @TargetPercentHPDamage@% max Health magic damage and healing for @LifestealPercent@% of the damage dealt.

Hold: Warwick lunges and clamps his jaws on the target, leaping behind them. While clamped, Warwick follows all movement of the target. After releasing his hold, he does the same damage and healing.
This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects, and does not Critically Strike.
While clamped, Warwick is immune to displacement.
